options.content: Diese MVP-Ansicht zeigt beobachtete Erzeugung bzw. physische Grenzfluesse als gestapelte Dispatch-Schichten und kombiniert sie mit statischen Grenzkosten- bzw. Opportunitaetskosten-Proxies. Sie ist keine Merit-Order-Kurve und weist keine preissetzenden Kraftwerke aus. Das zweite Zeitreihenpanel stackt MW-Mengen nach Kosten- beziehungsweise Preisband. Das dritte Panel zeigt die reinen Kosten- und Preisproxy-Linien in ct/kWh. Physische Importe sind keine Herkunftsnachweise.

panels.title: Dispatch- und Grenzkostenschichten DE-LU
panels.description: Stacked dispatch layers are observed or proxy-split power values. The blue line is a day-ahead price proxy on the right axis. Physical imports do not identify generation origin or price-setting units.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    load_mw,
    residual_load_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(hydro_total_mw, 0), 0) AS hydro_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(biomass_mw, 0), 0) AS biomass_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_coal_mw, 0), 0) AS coal_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_gas_mw, 0), 0) AS gas_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_oil_mw, 0), 0) + greatest(coalesce(other_mw, 0), 0) AS oil_other_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
import_layers AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    CASE source
      WHEN 'AT' THEN '10 Import Oesterreich'
      WHEN 'CH' THEN '11 Import Schweiz'
      WHEN 'FR' THEN '12 Import Frankreich'
      WHEN 'NL' THEN '13 Import Niederlande'
      WHEN 'BE' THEN '14 Import Belgien'
      WHEN 'DK_1' THEN '15 Import Daenemark DK1'
      WHEN 'DK_2' THEN '16 Import Daenemark DK2'
      WHEN 'NO' THEN '17 Import Norwegen'
      WHEN 'SE' THEN '18 Import Schweden'
      WHEN 'CZ' THEN '19 Import Tschechien'
      WHEN 'PL' THEN '20 Import Polen'
      ELSE '80 Import ' || source
    END AS metric,
    greatest(avg(flow_mw), 0) AS value
  FROM heatwave_2026.flows_h
  WHERE target = 'DE_LU'
    AND flow_mw > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY timestamp, source
),
domestic_layers AS (
  SELECT time, '01 Wasserkraft' AS metric, hydro_mw AS value FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '02 Biomasse', biomass_mw FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '03 Braunkohle', coal_mw * 0.62 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '04 Steinkohle', coal_mw * 0.38 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '05 Gas CCGT', gas_mw * 0.82 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '08 Gas OCGT', gas_mw * 0.18 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '09 Oel und sonstige Konventionelle', oil_other_mw FROM m
),
stack_layers AS (
  SELECT * FROM domestic_layers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM import_layers
),
stack_sum AS (
  SELECT time, sum(value) AS stack_mw
  FROM stack_layers
  GROUP BY time
),
positive_residual AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    '99 Nicht zugeordnet / Bilanz' AS metric,
    greatest(coalesce(m.residual_load_mw, 0) - coalesce(s.stack_mw, 0), 0) AS value
  FROM m
  LEFT JOIN stack_sum s USING (time)
),
price AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, price_eur_mwh / 10.0 AS price_ct_kwh
  FROM heatwave_2026.prices_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM stack_layers
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM positive_residual
) layers
WHERE value > 0
UNION ALL
SELECT time, 'Residuallast [MW]' AS metric, residual_load_mw AS value
FROM m
UNION ALL
SELECT time, 'Day-ahead Preis DE-LU [ct/kWh]' AS metric, price_ct_kwh AS value
FROM price
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Preis-Mengen-Schichten: Menge je Kosten-/Preisband [MW]
panels.description: Stacked MW volumes grouped by cost or price band. Each tooltip row answers: how many MW of which layer were assigned to which ct/kWh band in the selected hour.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    residual_load_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(hydro_total_mw, 0), 0) AS hydro_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(biomass_mw, 0), 0) AS biomass_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_coal_mw, 0), 0) AS coal_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_gas_mw, 0), 0) AS gas_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(fossil_oil_mw, 0), 0) + greatest(coalesce(other_mw, 0), 0) AS oil_other_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
domestic_layers AS (
  SELECT time, '01 Wasserkraft' AS layer, hydro_mw AS mw, 0.3::double precision AS price_ct_kwh FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '02 Biomasse', biomass_mw, 11.0 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '03 Braunkohle', coal_mw * 0.62, ((4.5 / 0.39) + (0.364 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 5.0) / 10.0 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '04 Steinkohle', coal_mw * 0.38, ((13.0 / 0.40) + (0.341 / 0.40 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '05 Gas CCGT', gas_mw * 0.82, ((42.0 / 0.58) + (0.201 / 0.58 * 70.0) + 3.0) / 10.0 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '08 Gas OCGT', gas_mw * 0.18, ((42.0 / 0.39) + (0.201 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0 FROM m
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '09 Oel und sonstige Konventionelle', oil_other_mw, ((75.0 / 0.36) + (0.267 / 0.36 * 70.0) + 6.0) / 10.0 FROM m
),
import_layers AS (
  SELECT
    f.timestamp AS time,
    CASE f.source
      WHEN 'AT' THEN '10 Import Oesterreich'
      WHEN 'CH' THEN '11 Import Schweiz'
      WHEN 'FR' THEN '12 Import Frankreich'
      WHEN 'NL' THEN '13 Import Niederlande'
      WHEN 'BE' THEN '14 Import Belgien'
      WHEN 'DK_1' THEN '15 Import Daenemark DK1'
      WHEN 'DK_2' THEN '16 Import Daenemark DK2'
      WHEN 'NO' THEN '17 Import Norwegen'
      WHEN 'SE' THEN '18 Import Schweden'
      WHEN 'CZ' THEN '19 Import Tschechien'
      WHEN 'PL' THEN '20 Import Polen'
      ELSE '80 Import ' || f.source
    END AS layer,
    avg(greatest(f.flow_mw, 0)) AS mw,
    avg(p.price_eur_mwh / 10.0) AS price_ct_kwh
  FROM heatwave_2026.flows_h f
  LEFT JOIN heatwave_2026.prices_h p
    ON p.timestamp = f.timestamp AND p.country = f.source
  WHERE f.target = 'DE_LU'
    AND f.flow_mw > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(f.timestamp)
  GROUP BY f.timestamp, f.source
),
priced_layers AS (
  SELECT * FROM domestic_layers
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM import_layers
),
stack_sum AS (
  SELECT time, sum(mw) AS stack_mw
  FROM priced_layers
  GROUP BY time
),
unassigned AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    '99 Nicht zugeordnet / Bilanz' AS layer,
    greatest(coalesce(m.residual_load_mw, 0) - coalesce(s.stack_mw, 0), 0) AS mw,
    NULL::double precision AS price_ct_kwh
  FROM m
  LEFT JOIN stack_sum s USING (time)
),
binned AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    layer,
    mw,
    CASE
      WHEN price_ct_kwh IS NULL THEN 'missing price'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 0 THEN '<0 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 4 THEN '00-04 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 8 THEN '04-08 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 12 THEN '08-12 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 16 THEN '12-16 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 20 THEN '16-20 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 25 THEN '20-25 ct/kWh'
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 30 THEN '25-30 ct/kWh'
      ELSE '30+ ct/kWh'
    END AS price_bin,
    CASE
      WHEN price_ct_kwh IS NULL THEN 99
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 0 THEN -1
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 4 THEN 0
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 8 THEN 4
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 12 THEN 8
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 16 THEN 12
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 20 THEN 16
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 25 THEN 20
      WHEN price_ct_kwh < 30 THEN 25
      ELSE 30
    END AS price_sort
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM priced_layers
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM unassigned
  ) layers
  WHERE mw > 0
)
SELECT
  time,
  price_bin || ' | ' || layer AS metric,
  sum(mw) AS value
FROM binned
GROUP BY time, price_bin, price_sort, layer
ORDER BY time, price_sort, layer

panels.title: Grenzkosten- und Importpreis-Proxies je Schicht [ct/kWh]
panels.description: Shows the cost or price proxy per visible dispatch layer. Domestic technologies use static MVP marginal-cost assumptions; import layers use the neighbor day-ahead price when that import is physically active.

targets.rawSql:
WITH times AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time
  FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
domestic_costs AS (
  SELECT time, '01 Wasserkraft' AS metric, 0.3::double precision AS value FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '02 Biomasse', 11.0 FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '03 Braunkohle', ((4.5 / 0.39) + (0.364 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 5.0) / 10.0 FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '04 Steinkohle', ((13.0 / 0.40) + (0.341 / 0.40 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0 FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '05 Gas CCGT', ((42.0 / 0.58) + (0.201 / 0.58 * 70.0) + 3.0) / 10.0 FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '08 Gas OCGT', ((42.0 / 0.39) + (0.201 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0 FROM times
  UNION ALL SELECT time, '09 Oel und sonstige Konventionelle', ((75.0 / 0.36) + (0.267 / 0.36 * 70.0) + 6.0) / 10.0 FROM times
),
import_power AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, source AS country, avg(greatest(flow_mw, 0)) AS import_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.flows_h
  WHERE target = 'DE_LU'
    AND flow_mw > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY timestamp, source
),
import_costs AS (
  SELECT
    p.time,
    CASE p.country
      WHEN 'AT' THEN '10 Import Oesterreich'
      WHEN 'CH' THEN '11 Import Schweiz'
      WHEN 'FR' THEN '12 Import Frankreich'
      WHEN 'NL' THEN '13 Import Niederlande'
      WHEN 'BE' THEN '14 Import Belgien'
      WHEN 'DK_1' THEN '15 Import Daenemark DK1'
      WHEN 'DK_2' THEN '16 Import Daenemark DK2'
      WHEN 'NO' THEN '17 Import Norwegen'
      WHEN 'SE' THEN '18 Import Schweden'
      WHEN 'CZ' THEN '19 Import Tschechien'
      WHEN 'PL' THEN '20 Import Polen'
      ELSE '80 Import ' || p.country
    END AS metric,
    n.price_eur_mwh / 10.0 AS value
  FROM import_power p
  LEFT JOIN heatwave_2026.prices_h n
    ON n.timestamp = p.time AND n.country = p.country
  WHERE n.price_eur_mwh IS NOT NULL
),
de_lu_price AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, '00 Day-ahead DE-LU' AS metric, price_eur_mwh / 10.0 AS value
  FROM heatwave_2026.prices_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM de_lu_price
UNION ALL
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM domestic_costs
UNION ALL
SELECT time, metric, value
FROM import_costs
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Kostenannahmen und Preisbins
panels.description: Thermische Kosten nutzen statische MVP-Annahmen; 1 ct/kWh = 10 EUR/MWh.

targets.rawSql:
WITH costs AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('01 Wasserkraft', 0.3::double precision, '0-4', 'observed_power_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('02 Biomasse', 11.0, '8-12', 'observed_power_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('03 Braunkohle', ((4.5 / 0.39) + (0.364 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 5.0) / 10.0, '8-12', 'observed_aggregate_split_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('04 Steinkohle', ((13.0 / 0.40) + (0.341 / 0.40 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0, '8-12', 'observed_aggregate_split_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('05 Gas CCGT', ((42.0 / 0.58) + (0.201 / 0.58 * 70.0) + 3.0) / 10.0, '8-12', 'observed_aggregate_split_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('08 Gas OCGT', ((42.0 / 0.39) + (0.201 / 0.39 * 70.0) + 4.0) / 10.0, '12-16', 'observed_aggregate_split_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('09 Oel und sonstige Konventionelle', ((75.0 / 0.36) + (0.267 / 0.36 * 70.0) + 6.0) / 10.0, '25-30', 'observed_power_static_cost_proxy'),
    ('Batteriespeicher', NULL::double precision, 'missing', 'missing_observed_storage_power'),
    ('Pumpspeicher', NULL::double precision, 'missing', 'missing_observed_storage_power')
  ) AS t(layer, estimated_cost_ct_kwh, price_bin, quality_flag)
)
SELECT layer, round(estimated_cost_ct_kwh::numeric, 2) AS estimated_cost_ct_kwh, price_bin, quality_flag
FROM costs
ORDER BY layer

panels.title: Import-Proxies im gewaehlten Zeitraum
panels.description: Nachbarpreise sind nur Preis-Proxies fuer physische Fluesse.

targets.rawSql:
WITH import_power AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, source AS country, avg(greatest(flow_mw, 0)) AS import_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.flows_h
  WHERE target = 'DE_LU'
    AND flow_mw > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY timestamp, source
),
neighbor_prices AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, country, price_eur_mwh / 10.0 AS price_ct_kwh
  FROM heatwave_2026.prices_h
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT
  p.country,
  round(avg(p.import_mw)::numeric, 1) AS avg_import_mw,
  round(avg(n.price_ct_kwh)::numeric, 2) AS avg_neighbor_price_ct_kwh,
  CASE
    WHEN count(n.price_ct_kwh) = 0 THEN 'physical_flow_missing_neighbor_price'
    ELSE 'physical_flow_neighbor_price_proxy'
  END AS quality_flag,
  'Physischer grenzueberschreitender Fluss; daraus laesst sich keine eindeutige Preiswirkung oder Herkunft der Erzeugung ableiten.' AS interpretation_note
FROM import_power p
LEFT JOIN neighbor_prices n
  ON n.time = p.time AND n.country = p.country
GROUP BY p.country
ORDER BY avg_import_mw DESC

panels.title: Bilanzabweichung
panels.description: BalanceError = Residuallast - dargestellte Schichten. Abweichungen sind im MVP sichtbar dokumentiert.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    residual_load_mw,
    greatest(coalesce(hydro_total_mw, 0), 0)
      + greatest(coalesce(biomass_mw, 0), 0)
      + greatest(coalesce(fossil_coal_mw, 0), 0)
      + greatest(coalesce(fossil_gas_mw, 0), 0)
      + greatest(coalesce(fossil_oil_mw, 0), 0)
      + greatest(coalesce(other_mw, 0), 0) AS domestic_stack_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
  WHERE country = 'DE_LU'
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
imports AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(greatest(flow_mw, 0)) AS import_mw
  FROM heatwave_2026.flows_h
  WHERE target = 'DE_LU'
    AND flow_mw > 0
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  GROUP BY timestamp
),
balance AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    residual_load_mw - domestic_stack_mw - coalesce(import_mw, 0) AS balance_error_mw
  FROM m
  LEFT JOIN imports USING (time)
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS hours,
  round(avg(abs(balance_error_mw))::numeric, 1) AS avg_abs_balance_error_mw,
  round(max(abs(balance_error_mw))::numeric, 1) AS max_abs_balance_error_mw,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE abs(balance_error_mw) > 500.0) AS hours_above_500_mw
FROM balance

options.content:
- Gas CCGT/OCGT und Braunkohle/Steinkohle sind aus aggregierten ENTSO-E-Gruppen statisch gesplittet.
- Historische Brennstoff- und EUA-Preise sind in diesem MVP nicht angebunden.
- Speicher werden ohne beobachtete Entladeleistung nicht als eigene aktive Schicht gezeigt.
- Grafana kann die gewuenschte HTML-Hover-Tabelle und per-Segment-Farbwechsel nur naeherungsweise abbilden.
